title: TOHSENO owner ladder
description: An ordered set of steps the owner performs. Steps describe human work TOHSENO cannot do. The ladder is versioned and digested as a unit so it can be refreshed when an external authority changes its flow, independently of the CLI release.

authority.description: Whose rules this ladder encodes. TOHSENO does not own these steps and cannot guarantee they are current beyond reviewedOn.

reviewedOn.description: ISO date this ladder was last verified against the authority. Staleness is a truth claim, not a nicety.

line.description: The single line shown to the owner. This is the entire terminal projection of this step. No second sentence.

url.description: Where the owner goes to do it. Rendered as the copy-pasteable next step.

requires.description: Step ids that must be complete first. Defines ladder order.

appliesWhen.description: Manifest conditions. Absent means the step always applies.

detector.description: How TOHSENO knows this step is done. `manual` means the owner ticks the box; nothing else can observe it.

path.description: file detector: path relative to the shot root.

glob.description: file detector: at least `minMatches` files matching this glob.

tool.description: command detector: must name a tool in the pinned trusted-tools allowlist. Detectors never run arbitrary commands.

expectPattern.description: command detector: step is complete when stdout matches this pattern and the exit code is 0.

cost.description: Money the owner spends. TOHSENO never spends it for them on the local path.

waitsOn.description: An external party the owner then waits on, with an observed range. Absent means the step completes when the owner finishes it.

irreversible.description: True when the step cannot be undone by the owner. These always require explicit approval and are never auto-advanced.
